record.what_it_does: Firecrawl is an API that crawls, scrapes, searches, and interacts with websites and returns the content as clean markdown, HTML, or structured JSON for use by AI/LLM applications.
record.auth_notes: The core REST API (scrape, crawl, map, search, extract, interact) uses a static API key ('fc-...') sent as an Authorization: Bearer header; no OAuth2 flow exists for the API itself. OAuth2 only appears on the hosted MCP server, used for interactive client account-linking (e.g. Claude.ai/ChatGPT connectors), not for direct API calls. A keyless mode exists for limited, rate-limited scrape/search/parse.
record.access_notes: Free account gives 1,000 credits/month (roughly 1,000 pages or ~500 searches) with no credit card required, and API calls even work keyless (rate-limited) with no signup at all. Paid tiers (Hobby/Standard/Growth/Scale/Enterprise) exist for higher volume/concurrency but are not required to obtain working credentials.
